```plato
    //==
    // # Prism3D
    //
    // The base swept along Offset. Precondition throughout: Offset is not parallel
    // to the base plane (the prism would have zero height and the containment test
    // would divide by zero).

    // |vectorArea . Offset| — the base area times the component of Offset
    // perpendicular to the base, which is the prism's height. Correct for an
    // oblique prism (Cavalieri's principle).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prism_(geometry)#Volume
    Volume(p: Prism3D): Number
        => p.Base.Points.VectorArea.Dot(p.Offset).Abs;
```

## Line 423

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 423](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L423).

```plato

    //==
    // # Pyramid3D
    //
    // Precondition throughout: the Apex is not in the base plane (the declaration's
    // stated degenerate case).

    // (1/3) * baseArea * height, with the height the perpendicular distance from
    // the Apex to the base plane — written as |vectorArea . (Apex - P0)| / 3.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyramid_(geometry)#Volume
    Volume(y: Pyramid3D): Number
        => y.Base.Points.VectorArea.Dot(y.Base.Points.First.Between(y.Apex)).Abs / 3.0;
```
